BMW Plans Significant Job Cuts Amidst Industry Pressures

BMW is reportedly planning to cut up to 8,000 jobs globally by the end of 2027. The layoffs are expected to affect administrative and development divisions, with production operations remaining unaffected. This move comes as the company faces increased pressure from Chinese competitors, prompting cost-cutting measures across Europe's largest carmakers. BMW currently employs approximately 154,000 people worldwide.
